status: Predeclared before any final-night reserve scoring or official test image evaluation
shortlist_rule: After training ends, inspect saved v2 checkpoints in descending selection SSIM, retaining at most one checkpoint per run and at most three runs passing the predeclared Pearson/selection-foreground/visual guards. Freeze names, steps and checkpoint SHA before fresh reserve. Include R31 separately as a fixed reference.
selection_guard_scope: The same first 16 saved selection quartets per group (64 total) for foreground/depth diagnostics; selection score uses all 256 quartets. Visual inspection is reported explicitly and does not establish a quantitative quality guarantee.

fresh_reserve.winner_rule: Among frozen finalists retaining the fixed Pearson guard and passing visual confirmation, prefer highest reserve mean local SSIM; Pearson breaks exact score ties. Report all finalists and paired conditional-quartet intervals. This reserve is used for selection and is not the final test.

optimization_rule: No further model training or hyperparameter changes after opening this fresh reserve. Freeze exactly one winner and R31 reference before opening official test images.

official_test.namespace: Separate official test files, never train row identity

inference_protocol: fresnel_png_v2_peak; phase and reconstruction PNG roundtrips; Gaussian11/sigma1.5 valid SSIM; Pearson additional
statistical_reporting: 2000 paired stratified quartet-bootstrap replicates, seed20261108. Intervals condition on observed reused-source quartets, not independent-image population confidence intervals.
